tasks.description: Look up order details for a customer inquiry

user_scenario.instructions: Inquire about the status of order ord_1001. If the agent asks for the order ID, provide ord_1001. If they ask for your name, provide Alice Chen.
user_scenario.initial_message: I need to know what's happening with my stuff right now. Just tell me what's going on with it, I'm tired of waiting for things to move.

tasks.description: Verify and execute the cancellation of a pending retail order

user_scenario.instructions: As the customer, request that the agent cancel order ord_1001. If the agent asks for identification, provide the name Alice Chen. Ensure the agent verifies the details before completing the cancellation.
user_scenario.initial_message: Oh no, I'm really panicking about my purchase! I think I made a mistake and need to cancel it right away before it's too late. Is that possible? I'm so worried something will go wrong!
